scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run db:setup && turbo run dev --filter=web --filter=api --filter=judge-worker --concurrency 15
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile hybrid up -d --remove-orphans --wait --wait-timeout 120 mysql redis judge0-server judge0-workers judge0-local-proxy
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile hybrid stop mysql redis judge0-db judge0-redis judge0-server judge0-workers judge0-local-proxy
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run build:packages
